# Fyne GUI Roadmap Implementation Complete

## Overview
All 7 targets from the GUI toolkit roadmap have been successfully implemented and verified with `go build ./...`

## Implemented Features

### Target 1: Application Metadata API
**Files:** `app/meta.go`, `app.go`
- Added `AppMetadata` struct with fields: ID, Name, Version, Icon, Build, Custom
- Added `App.Metadata() AppMetadata` method to fyne.App interface
- Updated all app implementations to include Metadata() method

### Target 2: JSON Theme Support
**Files:** `theme/json.go`
- Implemented `FromJSON(jsonData []byte) (fyne.Theme, error)`
- Implemented `FromJSONReader(r io.Reader) (fyne.Theme, error)`
- Added JSON parsing for colors (dark/light variants), sizes, fonts, and icons
- Includes hex color parsing with support for #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA formats
- Fallback to DefaultTheme() for missing values

### Target 3: Data Binding Sprintf
**Files:** `data/binding/sprintf.go`
- Implemented `NewSprintf(format string, bindings ...DataItem) String`
- Supports formatting with Bool, Float, Int, Rune, String, and URI bindings
- Bidirectional binding with format parsing for single-item bindings
- Auto-updates when source bindings change

### Target 4: Menu & Toolbar Enhancements
**Files:** `menu.go`, `widget/toolbar.go`
- Added `MenuItem.Icon` and `MenuItem.Shortcut` fields
- Added `Menu.Refresh()` and `MainMenu.Refresh()` methods
- Added `ToolbarAction.SetIcon(Resource)` method
- Changed Action() return type from `widget.ToolbarItem` to concrete types

### Target 5: Container & Widget Enhancements
**Files:** `container/container.go`, `widget/hyperlink.go`, `widget/entry.go`, `data/validation/all.go`
- `Container.RemoveAll()` - removes all objects from container
- `Container.Add()` - nil-safe addition
- `Hyperlink.OnTapped` callback field
- `Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(int)` method
- `validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator)` - validator combinator

### Target 6: Container Validation Fix
**File:** `data/validation/all.go`
- Corrected `NewAllStrings` to be a validator combinator (not whitelist validator)
- Takes variadic `fyne.StringValidator` arguments
- Returns first error or nil if all validators pass

### Target 7: Desktop App Interface
**Files:** `driver/desktop/app.go`, `desktop.go`
- Added `desktop.App` interface extending `fyne.App`
- Methods: `SetSystemTrayMenu(*fyne.Menu)`, `SetSystemTrayIcon(fyne.Resource)`

## Build Fixes Applied

### sprintf.go
- Removed references to `Bytes` binding type (not in binding package)
- Removed unused `fyne` import

### json.go
- Changed `Default()` calls to `DefaultTheme()`
- Changed `fyne.VariantDark/Light` to `VariantDark/Light` (theme package constants)
- Changed `fyne.LoadResourceFromURI` to `storage.LoadResourceFromURI`

### test/testapp.go

cd /app && go build ./...
```

11. `/app/driver/desktop/app.go` - Desktop App interface
12. `/app/desktop.go` - Desktop type alias
13. `/app/test/testapp.go` - Added Metadata() method

- Documentation includes "Since: 2.2" tags for new APIs
- Error handling includes proper fallbacks and logging
- Thread-safety maintained with appropriate locking where needed

# Fyne GUI Roadmap Implementation Complete

## Overview
All 7 targets from the GUI toolkit roadmap have been successfully implemented and verified with `go build ./...`

## Implemented Features

### Target 1: Application Metadata API
**Files:** `app/meta.go`, `app.go`
- Added `AppMetadata` struct with fields: ID, Name, Version, Icon, Build, Custom
- Added `App.Metadata() AppMetadata` method to fyne.App interface
- Updated all app implementations to include Metadata() method

### Target 2: JSON Theme Support
**Files:** `theme/json.go`
- Implemented `FromJSON(jsonData []byte) (fyne.Theme, error)`
- Implemented `FromJSONReader(r io.Reader) (fyne.Theme, error)`
- Added JSON parsing for colors (dark/light variants), sizes, fonts, and icons
- Includes hex color parsing with support for #RGB, #RGBA, #RRGGBB, #RRGGBBAA formats
- Fallback to DefaultTheme() for missing values

### Target 3: Data Binding Sprintf
**Files:** `data/binding/sprintf.go`
- Implemented `NewSprintf(format string, bindings ...DataItem) String`
- Supports formatting with Bool, Float, Int, Rune, String, and URI bindings
- Bidirectional binding with format parsing for single-item bindings
- Auto-updates when source bindings change

### Target 4: Menu & Toolbar Enhancements
**Files:** `menu.go`, `widget/toolbar.go`
- Added `MenuItem.Icon` and `MenuItem.Shortcut` fields
- Added `Menu.Refresh()` and `MainMenu.Refresh()` methods
- Added `ToolbarAction.SetIcon(Resource)` method
- Changed Action() return type from `widget.ToolbarItem` to concrete types

### Target 5: Container & Widget Enhancements
**Files:** `container/container.go`, `widget/hyperlink.go`, `widget/entry.go`, `data/validation/all.go`
- `Container.RemoveAll()` - removes all objects from container
- `Container.Add()` - nil-safe addition
- `Hyperlink.OnTapped` callback field
- `Entry.SetMinRowsVisible(int)` method
- `validation.NewAllStrings(validators ...fyne.StringValidator)` - validator combinator

### Target 6: Container Validation Fix
**File:** `data/validation/all.go`
- Corrected `NewAllStrings` to be a validator combinator (not whitelist validator)
- Takes variadic `fyne.StringValidator` arguments
- Returns first error or nil if all validators pass

### Target 7: Desktop App Interface
**Files:** `driver/desktop/app.go`, `desktop.go`
- Added `desktop.App` interface extending `fyne.App`
- Methods: `SetSystemTrayMenu(*fyne.Menu)`, `SetSystemTrayIcon(fyne.Resource)`

## Build Fixes Applied

### sprintf.go
- Removed references to `Bytes` binding type (not in binding package)
- Removed unused `fyne` import

### json.go
- Changed `Default()` calls to `DefaultTheme()`
- Changed `fyne.VariantDark/Light` to `VariantDark/Light` (theme package constants)
- Changed `fyne.LoadResourceFromURI` to `storage.LoadResourceFromURI`

### test/testapp.go
- Added `Metadata() AppMetadata` method to satisfy fyne.App interface

cd /app && go build ./...

6. `/app/widget/toolbar.go` - Toolbar enhancements

9. `/app/widget/entry.go` - SetMinRowsVisible

11. `/app/driver/desktop/app.go` - Desktop App interface

## Notes
- All implementations follow existing Fyne patterns and conventions
- Documentation includes "Since: 2.2" tags for new APIs
- Error handling includes proper fallbacks and logging
- Thread-safety maintained with appropriate locking where needed
